The main Study 2 veracity-by-treatment interaction directly tests the nudge effect on discernment. Preserve printed β = 0.039 without conversion or unsupported standardized-beta classification: Study 2 Analysis specifies rescaling sharing intentions from 1–6 to 0–1, not z scoring. Same-test p is printed p < .0001 (bound l), retained here only as contextual evidence because p is unassigned.
